items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Buster's a strong trombone player. Yeah, they're strong.

ctx.x: a trombone player for him a week before Miley Graw. But Anderson said, well no, I didn't promise it to so and so. And the saxophone player said, you see, I could have got you a good man. But no, you said you had me. Well, there it is. What's that?
The Buster's a strong trombone player. Yeah, they're strong.
